reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass. Gate 1: `getAllUsersWithStatus` has live non-test callers (`src/app/admin/page.tsx:35`, `src/app/actions-new.ts:31`) — not dead code. Gate 2: attack entry point is a direct HTTP POST from an authenticated non-admin user — no trust_assumptions field classifies this as trusted. Gate 3: `src/app/actions.ts` is explicitly in scope and PII leakage via server actions is a listed key_security_concern. Severity upgraded MEDIUM→HIGH: the function uses `createSupabaseAdminClient()` (SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, full RLS bypass) and returns `discord_uid`, `student_number`, `card_id`, and `is_admin` for ALL members; the admin-role gate exists only in `admin/layout.tsx` (UI redirect) and is bypassed entirely by a direct POST with the `Next-Action` header. An attacker can trigger this via a direct HTTP POST to the application using their valid session cookie and the `Next-Action` header ID for `getAllUsersWithStatus` (discoverable from the deployed JS bundle), causing full mass PII disclosure of all members' discord_uid, student_number, card_id, and is_admin without any admin privilege.
